facts.text: The hotel is in the Kloof Street Neighbourhood in Gardens, Cape Town, with Table Mountain rising behind.
facts.excerpt: Kloof Street Neighbourhood in Gardens - Cape Town's creative heart with Table Mountain rising behind.

facts.text: The hotel is a restored National Monument dating from the 1800s.
facts.excerpt: Restored 1800s National Monument, twenty minutes from the airport, five-minute walk to galleries, restaurants, and independent shops where locals actually go.

facts.text: Galleries, restaurants and independent shops are a five-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: five-minute walk to galleries, restaurants, and independent shops where locals actually go.

facts.text: The hotel is twenty minutes from the airport.
facts.excerpt: Twenty minutes from the airport, you arrive at Cape Town's creative heart.

facts.text: The wellness centre features TheraVine Cape botanical treatments from the surrounding winelands.
facts.excerpt: A wellness centre featuring TheraVine™ Cape botanical treatments from surrounding winelands.

facts.text: The hotel has two temperature-controlled pools and a fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Two temperature-controlled pools, fitness centre, and treatment rooms where city adventures pause.

facts.text: Superior Luxury Rooms have separate lounge areas, private sun terraces, and en-suite bathrooms with both bath and shower.
facts.excerpt: Separate lounge areas, private sun terraces, and en-suite bathrooms with both bath and shower create genuine space to spread out.

facts.text: Luxury Rooms have their own private sun terrace.
facts.excerpt: Six Luxury Rooms give you space to breathe with generous bedrooms, en-suite bathrooms, and your own private sun terrace.

facts.text: Each Stable Suite has a lounge area and kitchenette, with some offering courtyards or Juliet balconies.
facts.excerpt: Each suite features lounge area and kitchenette, with some offering courtyards or Juliet balconies.

facts.text: Family Stable Suites have two-bedroom configurations and interleading options.
facts.excerpt: Two Family Stable Suites provide our largest hotel accommodation with two-bedroom configurations and interleading options.

facts.text: The Cape Cadogan villa has three bedrooms, a private pool, a full kitchen and a breakfast chef.
facts.excerpt: 6 GUESTS \| 3 BEDROOMS \| PRIVATE POOL \| FULL KITCHEN \| BREAKFAST CHEF

facts.text: Rates include a full breakfast made to order at Upper Union Restaurant and afternoon drinks and canapes.
facts.excerpt: full breakfast made to order at Upper Union Restaurant, afternoon drinks and canapés, in-room coffee machine and bottled water

facts.text: Rates include access to the Mack & Madi kids' programme.
facts.excerpt: access to two temperature-controlled pools, wellness centre, fitness centre, Mack & Madi kids’ programme

facts.text: The hotel offers a community experience visiting Injongo Educare Centre in Mfuleni township.
facts.excerpt: Visit Injongo Educare Centre in Mfuleni township, where shipping containers become vibrant classrooms.

facts.text: The hotel arranges helicopter flights over Cape Town's Atlantic coastline and mountains.
facts.excerpt: soaring above dramatic Atlantic coastline, iconic mountains and world-famous landmarks on a flight tailored to your time and appetite.

facts.text: Upper Union Restaurant serves Chef Amori Burger's seasonal menus designed for sharing.
facts.excerpt: Upper Union Restaurant serves Chef Amori Burger's bold seasonal menus designed for sharing.

facts.text: An Impact Levy of R160 per room per night is not included in the rate.
facts.excerpt: Other: Impact Levy (R160 per room per night), gratuities, all flights and transfers not specified, cigars and cigarettes

facts.text: The original 19th-century Georgian house with Victorian influences is a listed national monument.
facts.excerpt: A listed national monument, the original 19th century Georgian house with Victorian influences was transformed into a small hotel
